maya: rolling out prefix-snapshot-cache v1 to reranking clusters (routes that call /rerank).

maya: quick TL;DR: median latency for rerank endpoints improved ~9%, p95 down ~22%, and token compute cost per request down ~15% on our sampled production mix.

ton y: can you share the canary metrics?

maya: canary (3h): baseline p95 = 420ms -> v1 p95 = 328ms, p50 = 95ms -> 86ms. average token compute units per call -15%. cache-hit for first-pass KV prefixes increased from 62% -> 83%.

ali: which routes/models were in scope?

maya: initial rollout: all /rerank routes with prefix_kv=true and seq <= 256. Models: rwd-rerank-1, rwd-rerank-1-quant, hosted-pegasus-rank-3b. Excluded live-stream rerank and long-context experimental routes.

nora: what does prefix-snapshot-cache actually do?

maya: short version: we take lightweight read-only snapshots of prefix KV state at request arrival and serve coalesced rerank microbatches from that stable view. This avoids repeated KV rehydration when many concurrent rerank requests share similar prefixes but differ in candidates. It also opportunistically writes tiny shared prefix slices into an LRU faststore to speed subsequent requests.

maya: config we flipped:
```
cache.mode = "prefix-snapshot"
cache.snapshot_ttl_ms = 500
cache.faststore_size_mb = 128
cache.snapshot_threshold = 3   # only snapshot when >3 concurrent elig requests
```

ton y: any regressions or surprises during canary?

maya: two small items: (1) a tenant with extremely high candidate churn caused snapshot churn and a transient p75 rise for 7 minutes; we mitigated by backoff on snapshot frequency for that tenant. (2) approx +3% memory usage on older nodes due to faststore allocations; autoscaler reclaimed a few hosts and load rebalanced. No customer payload loss.

deploy-bot: canary: prefix-snapshot-cache-v1 promoted to default in region-us-east-1 at 2026-09-08T13:47:11Z :white_check_mark:

ali: what alerts/dashboards did we add?

maya: dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood.com/d/prefix-cache/rerank-snapshot 
runbook: https://wiki.redwood.com/runbooks/prefix-snapshot-cache-v1 
alerts: cache.snapshot.churn.rate, cache.faststore.evictions.p90, rerank.p95.delta. Also a safety circuit: if cache-hit < 20% for 5m continuously, we auto-fallback to legacy path.

 nora: customers need to do anything?

maya: No API changes. Policy change: default rerank caching policy is now "snapshot-prefetch" for routes matching /rerank with seq<=256. Teams that need strict cache-coherency can opt out with `route.cache_policy = "no-snapshot"`.

al i: nice. please draft a one-paragraph announcement for #announcements and product channels. include opt-out note.

maya: will draft and post in the morning. big thanks to runtime + infra + sres for quick validation. :tada:

ali: follow-ups created: #5778 (dashboard opt-out counter), #5779 (snapshot backoff heuristics), #5780 (faststore memory cap tuning).

maya: closing this thread. ping me if you see any rerank p95 regressions.
